question: The sale of car results in __________.

options.text: decrease in sale of final products

solution:
The correct answer is __**increase in GDP**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The sale of a car is considered as the sale of a final product, which contributes positively to the Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

• When a car is sold, it is counted as part of the country's overall economic output.

• An increase in the sale of cars indicates higher consumer spending, which is a key component of GDP.

• Thus, the sale of a car results in an increase in GDP, reflecting economic growth and consumer confidence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**

• GDP is the total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country in a given period.

• It is a comprehensive measure of a nation's overall economic activity.

• GDP is used to gauge the health of a country's economy and to make international comparisons.

• There are three approaches to calculating GDP: the production (or output or value-added) approach, the income approach, and the expenditure approach.

• **Consumer Spending**

• Consumer spending, also known as consumption, is the amount of money spent by households in an economy on goods and services.

• It is the largest component of GDP, typically accounting for about two-thirds of total economic output.

• Higher consumer spending generally leads to higher production and economic growth.

• Factors influencing consumer spending include income levels, consumer confidence, interest rates, and inflation.

• **Economic Indicators**

• Economic indicators are statistical metrics used to measure the growth or decline of an economy.

• Some of the key economic indicators include GDP, unemployment rates, inflation, and consumer price index (CPI).

• These indicators help policymakers, economists, and investors make informed decisions.

• Positive indicators, such as an increase in GDP, suggest a healthy and growing economy.
